**(a)** ζ = 0.4

**(b)** Overshoot = exp(-πζ/√(1-ζ²))
= exp(-π·0.4/√(1-0.16)) = exp(-1.2566/0.9165) = exp(-1.3711) = 0.2538
≈ 25.4%

**(c)** Peak time: tp = πτ/√(1-ζ²) = π·3/0.9165 = 9.4248/0.9165 = 10.283 min

**(d)** Final value: K·M = 4·2 = 8
Max = 8·(1+overshoot) = 8·(1.2538) = 10.03

**(e)** Decay ratio = (overshoot)² = exp(-2πζ/√(1-ζ²)) = (0.2538)² = 0.0644
